record.title: GGEN fanout current
record.body: CELL1 R88 manufactured 50 new semantic SPARQL gates in the canonical ggen-ecosystem-ocel-pack. Exact marketplace base e88f3ad0d19223cec64e58998aceb21676661ffa; exact head d303e48748b085711586930718d5eeb2cada722b; draft PR #335. The 50 gates cover repository exact-subject identity, ManufacturingRun U/G/O/Q/M and obligation completeness, ManufacturingEvent identity/order/run/object integrity, GGEN primitive and qualification identity, typed refusal/falsifier integrity, partial-order structure, digest binding, causal provenance, and Project-memory object standing. Generated outputs were not edited. Exact-head CI had not yet produced workflow/status evidence at final inspection. Canonical ggen/ecosystem/ocel/current was not updated because no admitted pack-generated OCEL/Project request was produced in this run; O/Q/M were therefore not promoted.
